data.description:
The search endpoint end to end: strict query parsing, collected validation errors with field codes, the pipeline in one readable function, response mapping, plus the cities endpoint. Spec: docs/SPEC.md §5.2, §5.3, §5.4, §5.5, §6, §8 (httpapi list). Messages for field errors come from BRANDING.md §7.2 where a string exists.

Why: this is where "handle invalid input deliberately" is demonstrated. Unknown params are rejected, all problems are returned together, a page past the end is a 200, and a city with no matches is a 200. The pipeline function is the thing the interviewer reads when adding a requirement, so it must show its stages plainly.

Scope (package internal/httpapi):
- query.go: `ParseSearchQuery(url.Values) (SearchQuery, []FieldError)`. Allowlist of param names; anything else yields `unknown_param`. Empty value = absent. Numbers via strconv.ParseFloat; integers must be whole (`not_an_integer`). Rules and codes per §5.3/§5.5: negative, not_positive, out_of_range (pageSize 1..100, page >= 1), too_long (city 100, keyword 200), invalid_enum (status), min_gt_max reported once on maxPrice. Keyword split on whitespace into lowercase tokens. Status accepts repeats and comma-separated values; absent means all three. Defaults page 1, pageSize 10.
- search.go: handler for GET /api/listings/search implementing §6 in one function with a comment marking the dedupe slot. Dependencies: a Searcher interface (BC-4 store), a `Now func() time.Time` (main injects time.Now, tests inject a fixed clock). Maps domain output to the §5.4 JSON: rank, relevance rounded to four decimals, budgetFit null without budget, scoring block (weights 0/1 without budget, asOf = now UTC YYYY-MM-DD), appliedFilters with nulls.
- cities.go: GET /api/cities per §5.2.
- Tests per §8 httpapi list with httptest and a seeded :memory: store: every rule returns 400 with the right code and all errors collected; unknown param; page past end is 200 with empty items and correct metadata; empty city is 200 with totalItems 0; happy path for targetBudget=450000&city=Springfield with a fixed clock asserts rank order and the exact relevance numbers computed from §6.2; status filter; keyword with %; X-Request-ID present on every response.

Acceptance:
- Response bodies match §5.4 and §5.5 field for field (a test unmarshals into a struct with DisallowUnknownFields both ways).
- `make check` green.
- The pipeline function reads top to bottom as parse, search, [dedupe slot], rank, paginate, respond.

Validation: against the running API, curl the §10 smoke queries plus status=pending, keyword=%25 (encoded percent), pageSize=0, and minprice=1 (lowercase typo); paste the responses with --role validation.
data.title: Search API: strict query parsing, validation with field codes, pipeline handler, cities endpoint

data.body: From BC-2 (types frozen at review, branch feat/BC-2-backend-scaffold @ 5da9b80): domain.Listing.ListedDate is time.Time (a calendar date, midnight UTC); the JSON tags on Listing name the wire keys only. Never json.Marshal/Unmarshal Listing, or any struct embedding it (e.g. Scored), directly to or from the wire: time.Time encodes as RFC 3339 and rejects a bare YYYY-MM-DD. Parse and format the date with domain.DateLayout ("2006-01-02") in your own boundary record/DTO structs. The search response item must be its own DTO with listedDate formatted via domain.DateLayout; do not embed Listing/Scored in the JSON item.

From BC-3 (plan, not yet landed): SPEC §8's domain line 'each validation rule in §5.3' is covered in BC-5's httpapi tests per BC-5's own ticket; BC-3 does not test parser rules. BC-3 exports domain.MaxPageSize = 100 and sentinels domain.ErrPageOutOfRange / domain.ErrPageSizeOutOfRange (errors.Join'd when both are bad) from domain.Paginate as a defensive guard. BC-5's parser should enforce page >= 1 and pageSize 1..MaxPageSize first; it can map the sentinels with errors.Is if it wants a backstop.

From BC-3 review: domain.BudgetFit / domain.Rank have the documented precondition targetBudget > 0 (RankInput.TargetBudget nil or > 0). target 0 yields NaN/+Inf scores; there is no guard in domain by design. BC-5's parser must reject targetBudget <= 0 (not_positive) before calling Rank, as §5.3 requires.

Plan-review triage (art_01M4W58G75R2QWP2A8RQZQAR1H, PASS): 1 MAJOR complex -> malformed_query contract addition routed to the Orchestrator for ack/decline before in_progress (plan carries both outcomes). 4 MINOR obvious -> folded into the plan: whitespace-only keyword/city absent before length check; NO+Pets expected in rank order A5,A3,B9,A7; -0 normalised to +0 with raw-body assertion; SPEC edit 2 documents strconv.ParseFloat grammar + 1_000 test row. 1 MINOR outside plan -> validation-plan item 18 count (12 not 11) mailed to Orchestrator. Planner open questions: repeated scalars use first value (SPEC edit, no new code); BRANDING min_gt_max wording vs equal-allowed rule kept verbatim, branding owner's call. Resolutions block appended to the plan.

Orchestrator ACK (mail 01M4W6CS273Z25KP843BMQK92J): malformed_query approved (pseudo-field query, 400, at most one per request, decoded pairs still validated; SPEC §5.3 + §5.5 in-branch). Also in-branch SPEC §13 note 5 (min/max price copy) per Orchestrator. Plan Decisions 1-3 recorded. Merged master e5f49bb (BC-3 + BC-4 landed) at cd4c46a; implementer dispatched.

Code review cycle 1: headless lattice code-review was started at 03:30Z, then stopped by the delegator per run-state decision 03:22Z (diff master...HEAD is 2065+/9- changed lines, over the 1500-line threshold); its review_state shows the abandoned run, no artifact. own-reviewer fallback: fresh-context Opus reviewer sub-agent reviewing HEAD 75530c0 against master e5f49bb.

Review routing (art_01M4W7VYKS1KWBVC8R1NX7T89M, PASS-WITH-NITS @75530c0, no critical/major/minor): nits 1-4 (SPEC §5.3 wording: 10000-param cap returns malformed_query; lengths are Unicode code points; minPrice=&minPrice=5 example; HTML comment marking the §5.4/§5.5 examples as test-asserted) -> fix via nit-fix implementer, then re-review the new HEAD. Nit 5 (Unicode vs SQLite ASCII lower() keyword matching, pre-existing store behavior) -> new backlog task BC-20, linked related_to BC-5. Implementer deviations (2^53 cutoff inclusive, 'section' wording, SPEC-first commit order, extra §5.3 wording) accepted by reviewer.

own-reviewer fallback (cycle 2): diff exceeds 1500 changed lines (run-state decision 03:22Z). Re-review PASS @1871b01 (nit fixes fd15b4a + merge master 0e6730f); backend byte-identical to the cycle-1 PASS. Moving to in_validation.

Completion (delegator): Built GET /api/listings/search and GET /api/cities in backend/internal/httpapi. query.go: ParseSearchQuery(url.Values) (SearchQuery, []FieldError) with allowlist exported as SearchQueryParams() (BC-6 param-sync test reads it), every §5.3/§5.5 rule and code, errors collected in a deterministic order (malformed_query, then §5.3 table order, then unknown params by name), min_gt_max once on maxPrice, status repeats/commas, keyword tokens. search.go: searchListings reads parse, search, dedupe slot, rank, paginate, respond; own wire DTOs (listedDate via domain.DateLayout, four-decimal rounding in httpapi, budgetFit null without budget, weights 0/1). cities.go: §5.2. Router: one line per route; Deps gain Searcher, Cities, Now (default time.Now); main.go wires the store and time.Now. Tests: 22 new test functions / 166 subtests incl. DisallowUnknownFields round trip both ways on every 200/400 body and the §5.4/§5.5 SPEC examples asserted from docs/SPEC.md. SPEC edits (deviation rule): §5.4 example score 0.8731 -> 0.7414 with arithmetic; §5.3 parsing rules pinned (non-finite = not_a_number, integers >= 2^53 out_of_range, whitespace-only absent, status normalisation, first-value rule, ParseFloat grammar, code-point lengths, error order, malformed_query incl. 10000-param cap); §5.5 adds malformed_query (Orchestrator ACK); §13 note 5 (min/max price copy). Implementer deviations accepted by review: 2^53 cutoff inclusive; 'section N' comment wording; SPEC-first commit order. Findings routed: plan review 1 major (Orchestrator ACK) + 4 minor folded + 1 to Orchestrator (validation-plan row 18 fixed); code review cycle 1 PASS-WITH-NITS, nits 1-4 fixed (fd15b4a), nit 5 -> BC-20; cycle 2 PASS @1871b01. Validation 42/42 PASS on :18005. Follow-up tickets: BC-20.
